species: mouse (humanized Berkeley sickle cell HbSS-BERK, female, 18-21 months)
condition_other: sickle cell disease (humanized sickle mouse model of chronic hyperalgesia, aged)
readout_other: hot-plate hind paw withdrawal latency (delta hPWL); rotarod latency to fall
direction_notes: Single-session tFUS at a PRF of 40 Hz targeting S1HL and AI together with a single-element transducer increased delta hPWL at 10 and 15 min versus negative control (reduced heat hyperalgesia); single-circuit stimulation with the 128-element array (S1HL, AI or M1) did not differ from negative control.
safety_notes: Rotarod latency to fall did not differ from baseline or negative control after tFUS (N = 5); behavioural safety assessment only.

exposures.label: Single-element transducer, simultaneous S1HL and AI

target.label: hindlimb of the primary somatosensory cortex (S1HL) and agranular insular (AI)

device.model: AT31529 single-element, driven by custom battery-powered ultrasound analog front end (UAFE)

timing.protocol_description: Tone burst duration 200 us, PRF 40 Hz, ultrasound duration 400 ms, inter-sonication interval 4 s, total sonication time 20 min, single session; hind paw withdrawal latency tested 10 and 15 min after.
